resolution: An empty query remains a valid exploratory query. An absent allowlist or backend shows the specific setup guidance in Copywriting Contract beside the unavailable action; no duplicate Run button appears in the empty result state.
The sole Run search action retains its label and busy semantics while the existing guard prevents duplicate submission; the dispatched mode, targets, query and page size are captured together.
Invalid input or request/setup failure retains editable criteria and presents the actual reason plus the Copywriting Contract recovery path; failure is not announced as a completed response.
Single and multi-index modes use labeled native controls, complete target identifiers, query and page-size fields followed by one Run search submit in the declared reading order.
Missing required targets or invalid page-size/options receive associated validation without dispatching incomplete criteria; an intentionally blank query is not treated as incomplete.
